name: io.faultkey/causallayer-mcp
title: FaultKey · CausalLayer
description: Deterministic AI-liability attribution. Issues signed, Bitcoin-anchored CausalCertificateV1 receipts that compute vendor/deployer/user liability splits for AI incidents. Closed-form math, byte-identical reproducible, no LLMs in the scoring path.

tools.name: submit_incident
tools.description: Issue a CausalCertificateV1 attributing fault between vendor / deployer / user.

tools.name: verify_certificate
tools.description: Verify the signature and Bitcoin anchor of a CausalCertificateV1.

tools.name: get_anchor_status
tools.description: Look up the OpenTimestamps anchor status for a certificate.
